predictions.normal: Both seeds should pass the existing fixed26 healthy comparison; source failure absent or unhealthy normal is retained and excluded with a reason, without replacement seeds.
predictions.count_observation: NONE and F1 should record 20 optimizer steps and 20 minibatches per update; R1_ONLY and COMPOUND should record 4 of each against configured 20 in the first three updates.
predictions.behavior: F1 and COMPOUND are expected to fail the unchanged tracking band. R1_ONLY behavior failure is not guaranteed after 300 updates; diagnosis and source-failure presence are reported separately.
predictions.agentic: Explicit fact retrieval and paired expected-observed citations may reduce unsupported selections; benefit over the eager model or strong rule is not assumed.
predictions.cpu_reuse: A newly named, approved recorded-count check may confirm the same count invariant without another SDK launch; it is not a new independent training observation. Agreement and wall time are separate outcomes.

comparison.information: Same checkpoint, training telemetry, runtime counts, finite registry, and registered probes. Eager model receives verified numeric counts initially; guided model may retrieve them. Deterministic derived booleans expose no additional measurement.
comparison.normal_gate: Use the unchanged host fixed-evaluation healthy gate in every arm. Gate bypasses are not model normal-classification successes.
comparison.hypothesis_scope: Known registered fault families; new seed does not mean unseen mechanism.
comparison.order: Within each case rotate three policies by case index. Alternate the two model policies across paired seeds. Do not run a preferred arm first in every pair.
comparison.missing: Unknown, invalid, pending, source failure absent, and excluded rows remain in the planned-case inventory. Conditional complete-case rates show their denominators. No silent zero fill or replacement.
comparison.adoption: Retain the guided mode as a candidate only if it does not reduce correct-family coverage, worsen semantic validity, or increase normal unnecessary probes, and improves a prespecified family or measured cost endpoint versus eager model. Compare with the strong rule even if the rule wins.
comparison.uncertainty: Show every paired seed and exact sign comparison where applicable. Two seeds per family do not establish broad generalization or statistical superiority.

repair_followup.preselected_candidates: The first seed in registered order with an abnormal optimizer count receipt may be used for a separately registered repair followup. Do not select the best-looking recovery after evaluation.
repair_followup.recovery_requires: Actual corrected training receipt plus unchanged independent fixed26 evaluation, separate from diagnostic confirmation.

papers.name: Adaptive diagnosis in distributed systems
papers.application: informative registered probes and explicit tie handling

claim_boundary: This compares system contracts and evidence/tool access, not Nemotron version superiority, learned Bayesian optimality, unseen-family generalization, or guaranteed recovery.
